name: Epic Design (Cinematic 2.5D Parallax & Depth System)
purpose: Constructs immersive, cinematic 2.5D pseudo-3D layouts and motion stages using a formal 6-layer depth system, parallax scaling, and clip-path reveals without WebGL.
capabilities: 6-layer depth system (depth-0 to depth-5) with prescribed parallax, blur, and scale metrics
Hero-companion spatial hierarchy and companion scatter transitions
Inter-section floating elements and 2.5D perspective positioning
Directional clip-path reveals, curtain drops, and window pane iris transitions

compatibility.notes: Pure CSS/DOM and GSAP execution; zero WebGL overhead. Tested on Apple Silicon M2.

licensing.notes: MIT License verified upstream (alirezarezvani/claude-skills commit 04965836, author Abbas Mir).

security.notes: Includes read-only local scripts inspect-assets.py and validate-layers.js for asset and DOM depth inspection.

approval_evidence: Workspace Steward evaluation: Approved. Upstream verified from alirezarezvani/claude-skills (MIT License). Validated Antigravity compatibility. Bridges the gap between 2D flat composition and heavy 3D WebGL by defining a mathematically structured 6-layer depth model (scale, blur, parallax factor) and companion scatter mechanics that execute with sub-200MB RAM on Apple Silicon M2.
